plugin.name: Language Models
plugin.description: NVIDIA and Command Code as model providers for the agent.
plugin.longDescription: Adds NVIDIA's hosted models and Command Code's Provider API to Settings → Providers. Enter a provider's API key on this page and its models appear in the model menu; the list is read from the provider, so new models show up by themselves. Leave a key empty to leave that provider out.
config.nvidia.title: NVIDIA API key
config.nvidia.description: Starts with nvapi-. Create one at build.nvidia.com → API Keys.
config.commandCode.title: Command Code API key
config.commandCode.description: From Command Code Studio → Settings → API Keys, on the Provider plan. Claude models are only served through Command Code's own protocol and aren't listed.
